author: Zilong He and Yong Hu

formalizedScope: Theorem 1.1 complete right-hand-side statement layer with one-based to zero-based index translation
All directly numbered results in Section 2
Section 3 definitions and propositions through Proposition 3.7, including all Table 1 classification and Table 2 maximality rows
Lemmas 3.9-3.11 and 3.13-3.14 with literal published endpoint models
Lemma 4.2 complete equivalence using the exact square/discriminant tests and deep same-rank completion
Section 4 exact I1E-I3E condition layer, generic Theorem 2.8 universality factorization, Theorem 4.1 logical assembly, and Theorem 4.7 invariant conversion
Abstract O-maximal testing reduction underlying Theorem 1.2
excludedScope: Theorem 1.2 explicit testing list and minimality proof
Remarks 3.8 and 3.12 as explicit correspondence endpoints
Remaining numbered Section 4 endpoints pending Lemmas 4.3-4.5; all numbered results in Sections 5-6
reviewNotice: Section 2 and the numbered Section 3 core, including Proposition 3.7, are kernel checked. Lemma 4.2 is now kernel checked in both directions using the exact N_1^n(1) and N_1^n(Delta) tests and a deep same-rank completion. The exact Section 4 conditions, generic universality reduction, Theorem 4.1 assembly, and Theorem 4.7 invariant conversion are also checked, but Lemmas 4.4 and 4.5 remain open, so Theorems 4.1 and 4.7 are not yet claimed. Theorem 1.1 remains an unproved proposition target, and the proved maximal-testing theorem is only the abstract core of Theorem 1.2, not its explicit list or minimality assertion.
